desc: Generate all primes up to 1e6 using a sieve of Eratosthenes.
Enumerate all numbers of the form p^{2a} * q^{2b} ≤ 1e12 with distinct primes p < q and a, b ≥ 1, storing them in a set.
Convert the set to a sorted list `nums` for binary search.
Read Q and each query A, then for each A use `bisect_right(nums, A) - 1` to find the largest 400 number ≤ A and print it.
Test the implementation with the sample input to verify correctness.
